sections.title: Series overview
paragraphs: The official 0.5.4 Patch Notes state that Atziri's Vault has a chance to drop one of four Orb of Sacrifice currencies. The series upgrades Corrupted Enchantments and randomly removes one Explicit Modifier. The four variants, their individual names, and their probabilities remain unverified here.

steps.label: Record each variant separately
body: Record each confirmed variant name and tooltip separately when official or PC evidence identifies it.

steps.label: Record the acquisition context
body: Record the Atziri's Vault acquisition context without inferring a guaranteed drop or probability.

steps.label: Record the enchantment change
body: Record the Corrupted Enchantment before and after use, including the randomly removed Explicit Modifier.

sections.title: Publication boundary
paragraphs: Until each variant is independently confirmed, keep this page as a series mechanics Guide and do not create four Item pages from assumptions. Do not promise value, outcome, or compatibility with every Build.
